subject: Hosted API integration — architecture sync and dev deep-dive
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@quantumcare.com>, Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@quantumcare.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Hosted API integration — architecture sync and dev deep-dive

Hi Liam / Samantha,

Thanks for taking the time last week to evaluate Redwood. Per our conversation I want to set up a technical deep-dive focused on integrating the Hosted API into QuantumCare's ingestion and streaming pipeline. Proposed goals:
- Walk through SDK options (Python/Node), streaming usage patterns, and continuity for long-lived sessions
- Demonstrate function/tool calling and structured output handling for your workflow
- Discuss latency, batching, and KV cache considerations for conversational state

Proposed slots (all ET):
- Tue Jun 16, 11:00–12:00 ET
- Wed Jun 17, 09:00–10:00 ET

Please let me know which works or propose alternatives. Attendees we plan to include: myself (product + commercial), Hannah Schmitt (manager, solutions), and a technical engineer (I'll add once time is confirmed). I've attached a short integration_requirements.pdf with the pre-reads and suggested prework.

If you have any specific scenarios or sample payload shapes you'd like us to demo, paste them inline or attach — we can adapt the agenda.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0128

Attachments: integration_requirements.pdf

- We have a standing all-hands Tue 11:00 ET, so Tue Jun 16 conflicts. Wed Jun 17 09:00 ET works better.
- Could you include a short segment on SSO/KMS integration and expected audit log trails? That's a close ask from our InfoSec team.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=archsync
Agenda (60m):
- 10m: business context, success criteria (Ben)
- 20m: platform architecture + SDK overview (Dev)
- 20m: live streaming demo (SDK streaming + function calling) (Dev + Ava)
- 10m: SSO/KMS & audit logs (Hannah)

Prework: please review integration_requirements.pdf and, if possible, share a sample request/response shape for a conversational turn. That helps us prep the demo code.

Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — architecture sync and dev deep-dive

Thanks team — quick tech prep from my side. Suggested demo plan and prework items for QuantumCare engineers:

Demo plan (Wed Jun 17, 09:00–10:00 ET):
- 00–10m: high-level architecture and where Hosted API sits in a typical ingestion pipeline
- 10–35m: SDK deep-dive (Python streaming, Node SDK patterns) + live streaming demo showing partial token streaming and reconnect semantics
- 35–55m: function/tool calling example (structured JSON output + verification) and how we wire external services (webhooks, connectors)
- 55–60m: next steps and runbook (Dev + Ben)

Prework checklist (attached prework_checklist.md):
- Confirm one sample request/response shape and a representative token budget (max tokens per request)
- Provide expected QPS / concurrency (or a range) and max tolerable P95 latency for inference
- Confirm whether you want us to demo a stateful session with KV cache replay or a stateless approach

Attachments: streaming_demo.zip (demo code and small recorder), prework_checklist.md

Notes: for SDK streaming we'll demo the Python SDK's async iterator pattern and reconnection hints. If you have a short sample of a function you want the model to call (e.g., a clinical-coding webhook), paste it into the Drive doc linked below so we can wire it into the demo.

Drive (prep): https://drive.redwood.example/drive/folders/QC-Integration-Prep

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai
